secondaryValue: Gamma only, Gamma + Beta, Gamma + Beta + Alpha
fieldDescription: Which AI cores can support crewed ships. Cores that are no longer allowed are returned to cargo when you close the Fleet screen.

If enabled, Gamma Cores supporting crewed ships only get the regular (non-elite) versions of their skills, including skills picked with Change skills. If disabled, they keep elite skills like vanilla AI cores.
If enabled, Gamma Cores supporting crewed ships can't take Systems Expertise or Missile Specialization.

If enabled, ships supported by a Gamma Core count as having an officer for other skills (Carrier Group, Fighter Uplink, Coordinated Maneuvers, Wolfpack Tactics) and for battle difficulty (XP). AI Support Doctrine's own effects are unaffected.
